evidence.renderer: actual skinned/source-textured CPU mesh with simplified lighting
evidence.normal_speed_review: 30 fps encode generated, but local playback was blocked by cloud-browser URL policy; primary remains revise
evidence.webgl: public Lab attempted; THREE.WebGLRenderer failed to create a WebGL context

blocking.observation: Knee plane, free-arm silhouette, opponent focus, rotation, weight shifts, uppercut support and recovery were compared in actual-mesh three-quarter and side sequences.

primary.observation: Deeper slash load, wider follow-through, uppercut pelvis/chest sequencing, heavy chest lag and reverse-step counterbalance were improved in sequential captures. Browser WebGL failed and the local 30 fps encode could not be opened by the cloud-browser URL policy, so normal-speed actual-model review remains incomplete.

polish.observation: Wrist continuity was improved, but cloth/hair collision, WebGL/MToon and physical-device playback remain unverified.

iterations.finding: Knee plane stayed forward while support foot and pelvis turned.
iterations.correction: Drive the leg IK pole from support-foot heading.
iterations.result: Less crossed-knee silhouette; retained grounded contact.
iterations.remaining: Individual-pass normal-speed review and mesh collision review.

iterations.finding: Open free hand separated from the torso and weakened counterbalance.
iterations.correction: Compress the free-arm target and phase its finger curl.
iterations.result: Counterhand stays closer to the rib cage through release.
iterations.remaining: Individual-pass normal-speed review and clothing clearance.

iterations.finding: Head yaw followed the torso and briefly lost the opponent.
iterations.correction: Blend an opponent-focus counter-rotation into authored head yaw.
iterations.result: Facing direction remains steadier without a frozen neck.
iterations.remaining: Individual-pass normal-speed review and target-aware gameplay validation.

iterations.finding: Uppercut pelvis rose abruptly beneath the blade.
iterations.correction: Distribute leg drive before and through contact.
iterations.result: Final 30 Hz pelvis-height step is 0.0773229 m.
iterations.remaining: The reference still has stronger lateral travel and rotation.

iterations.finding: Local wrist reset inherited forearm twist and could snap at the guard seam.
iterations.correction: Restore the pre-IK neutral free-wrist world orientation after arm solve.
iterations.result: Free wrist keeps a consistent orientation across arm IK.
iterations.remaining: Finger/cloth collision and individual-pass normal-speed review.

iterations.finding: Uppercut recovery rose before the next slash loaded.
iterations.correction: Hold the low recovery through phase .73 before the connection.
iterations.result: The pelvis stays under the overhead finish longer before the next cut.
iterations.remaining: Individual-pass normal-speed review and stronger momentum transfer.

iterations.finding: Slash torso rotation lacked a strong pelvis lead.
iterations.correction: Widen opposing hip yaw through load, contact and follow-through.
iterations.result: Front-three-quarter frames show a clearer full-body turn while side support remains readable.
iterations.remaining: Normal-speed media-player review and stronger release spacing.

iterations.finding: Chest yaw crossed with the hips and flattened the kinetic chain.
iterations.correction: Retain chest coil through phase .46, then release after the pelvis.
iterations.result: Sequential frames retain a more closed load and a later shoulder turn.
iterations.remaining: Normal-speed media-player review; arm and blade still lack the reference acceleration.

iterations.finding: Composed slashes advanced almost straight ahead.
iterations.correction: Widen review-only slash root travel without changing combat movement.
iterations.result: The four-second root path spans 0.220 m laterally instead of 0.120 m.
iterations.remaining: The reference still traverses a much larger screen-space distance.

iterations.finding: The reverse cut released chest and hips together.
iterations.correction: Hold positive chest coil until phase .48 and cross after the hip turn.
iterations.result: Contact and recovery retain a delayed upper-body return in both views.
iterations.remaining: The visual difference is modest and requires normal-speed confirmation.

iterations.finding: The thrust rose through contact and lost its driving line.
iterations.correction: Keep pelvis displacement lower through extension and early recovery.
iterations.result: Actual-mesh contact pelvis height fell from 0.938 m to 0.894 m with the rear leg extended.
iterations.remaining: Foot pressure and cloth clearance need WebGL review.

iterations.finding: The heavy cut stood tall under its overhead hold.
iterations.correction: Deepen vertical compression through preload and downward release.
iterations.result: Sampled preload lowered by 80 mm and minimum pelvis height by 25 mm.
iterations.remaining: Normal-speed impact weight and recovery into guard remain unconfirmed.

iterations.finding: The slash blade began leaving the loaded shoulder too early.
iterations.correction: Retain the deep rearward blade pose through phase .44.
iterations.result: The blade stays near the shoulder longer before contact while the support silhouette remains planted.
iterations.remaining: Normal-speed acceleration and shoulder clearance remain unconfirmed.

iterations.finding: The slash follow-through arc stopped too soon after contact.
iterations.correction: Extend blade yaw and roll through phases .59 and .72.
iterations.result: Three-quarter frames show a wider cross-body overshoot without changing the recovery endpoint.
iterations.remaining: Normal-speed impact and cloth clearance remain unconfirmed.

iterations.finding: The uppercut rose through a narrow, almost square pelvis.
iterations.correction: Widen opposing pelvis yaw in load, release and overhead recovery.
iterations.result: The support leg and pelvis turn more visibly beneath the rising blade.
iterations.remaining: Rotation remains subtler than the reference and needs 1x confirmation.

iterations.finding: Uppercut hips and chest unwound at nearly the same time.
iterations.correction: Retain chest coil after pelvis release, then overtake into the finish.
iterations.result: Sequential views show pelvis-first release with stable sword attachment and support.
iterations.remaining: The difference is modest and requires normal-speed confirmation.

iterations.finding: The heavy-cut chest dropped with the hips and lost stored weight.
iterations.correction: Hold the chest through phase .48 and drop after pelvis release.
iterations.result: The side sequence retains the chest behind the pelvis before the downward drive.
iterations.remaining: Impact weight and recovery need normal-speed and cloth review.

iterations.finding: The reverse step did not counterbalance the preceding lateral slash.
iterations.correction: Widen review-composition back travel from [-.12,.40] to [-.18,.44].
iterations.result: Front frames show a clearer left-right phrase without changing gameplay movement.
iterations.remaining: The reference still traverses a larger distance and transfers more speed into the next cut.

iterations.finding: Lowered and widened the loading blade arc around the shoulder; inspected side and three-quarter mesh views.
Lowered the lead/recovery foot lift and deepened the pelvis/torso loading; reduced the marching-step silhouette.
Loaded the reverse cut from the preceding low follow-through. Rendered elbow stayed near 30 degrees throughout, revealing an IK reach-limit problem.
Added phase-dependent sword-hand reach. The native back cut now bends about 81 degrees during loading and extends at contact.
Lowered loading and raised the blade to a clear overhead apex. Inspection exposed a straight counterarm and insufficient planted-leg reserve.
Held the blade behind vertical before a faster downward release, with deeper torso hinge and lower step lift.
Compressed the loaded arm/torso and lengthened contact extension; preserved the original native hit clock.
Coupled the free arm and its pole to torso yaw, with a 90-percent reach reserve; eliminated its straight-arm apex.
Projected ground targets into reachable leg arcs and lowered rear lifts. Moving-rig verification exposed 17.76 mm of planted-toe slip at the uppercut apex; this pass was not accepted as final.
Lowered the uppercut apex to preserve knee reserve; the existing 5 mm planted-toe test passed without relaxing its threshold.
Carried original recovery through phase 0.80 and increased overlap from 80 to 140 ms. Contacts still use native clocks; high-to-low connection remained too abrupt.
Settled the uppercut under its overhead blade before the next slash. The largest remaining height step moved to the preceding back-to-uppercut join.
Kept the back-cut recovery low, eliminating its stand-up/reset before the next loading pose. Maximum 30 Hz pelvis height step fell to 90.2 mm.
Extended the slash grip forward at contact and through follow-through. Native slash elbow bend at contact changed from 67.8 to 30.4 degrees, visibly strengthening the forward cut.
